concept.hr: Provjera integriteta nađe loš blok i popravi ga iz zrcala
concept.en: A scrub finds a bad block and repairs it from the mirror

summary.hr: Tiho ošteti blok i pokreni provjeru: zbroj u pokazivaču otkrije lošu kopiju, a zrcalo je popravi. Jedan disk samo otkrije, md RAID 1 ni to.
summary.en: Silently damage a block and scrub: the checksum in the pointer catches the bad copy and the mirror repairs it. One disk only detects; md RAID 1 cannot tell.
